question: 各个品类的销售额、销量情况分布
gold_sql: select c.category_name, sum(oi.subtotal),sum(oi.quantity)from order_items oi left JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id left join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id left join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'group by c.category_name
raw_output:
SELECT c.category_name AS 品类,
       SUM(oi.subtotal) AS 销售额,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC;
